title: fix(plugin-auth)!: a completed password reset ends the account's other sessions; a reset request answers the same way for any address without waiting on its mail
body:
security#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the auth manager refuses an `emailAndPassword.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: false` it accepted before, at construction and on every configuration patch. Nothing is widened: no export, route, key or answer is added.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file teaches the reset doors or this key; the hand-written guides that do (`content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, `docs/HARDENING.md`) are updated in this diff.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:自助重置密码完成后,该账号此前的所有会话一律结束(与管理员强制重置一致,不是开关);显式配置 `revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: false` 改为启动即拒绝。重置请求对任何地址都同样作答,重置邮件改在响应之后发送,发送失败只记服务端日志。
- 为什么改:重置密码应当让旧登录失效;重置请求的回答不应随地址或邮件发送而变化。
- 风险与回滚:用户在其他设备上的登录会在重置后被登出(预期行为)。若某部署显式写了 `false`,升级后无法启动,删掉该键即可。回滚 = 还原本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`(`revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true` 与 `sendResetPassword` 外包的一行)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/run-after-response.ts`、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/password-reset-ends-sessions.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts src/reset-request-mail-after-response.test.ts`,预期两个文件全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **A completed password reset ends the account's other sessions.** The auth instance now always hands better-auth `emailAndPassword.revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: true`, so every reset door that sets a password from a reset token or code (the emailed link, and the phone OTP reset where it is mounted) ends every existing session of the account in the same unit as the password write — the same as an administrator's forced reset. It is not a setting.
- **`revokeSessionsOnPasswordReset: false` is refused, never silently overridden.** The key stays declared by `@objectstack/spec`. `assertPasswordResetEndsSessions` (new, `password-reset-ends-sessions.ts`) refuses an explicit `false` where the configuration enters the manager — the constructor (stops the boot) and `applyConfigPatch` (the standing configuration keeps ruling) — the way the plugin already treats a declaration it will not honour (`assertAudienceConfig`, `assertScimAdminCoherence`). `true` and an absent key are accepted.
- **A reset request answers the same way for any address, without waiting on its mail.** `sendResetPassword` is wrapped by `sendAfterResponseOnPublicDoor` (new, `run-after-response.ts`): a call that carries its `Request` (the public door) resolves at once and the mail is built and sent after the response (`setImmediate`, the shape `createRefusedAttachTombstoner` in service-storage already uses); a failure is logged on the server at error. A call with no `Request` — the identity import's server-side reset — is handed straight through and awaited as before, because it reads the delivery receipt the send settles.
- **Docs.** `docs/HARDENING.md` no longer asks operators to set the key; `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` states both rules.

## Tests

- `plugin-auth/src/password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts` (new): the session signed in before a completed reset answers `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` afterwards (through the emailed link and, the same, through the phone OTP reset — `/phone-number/request-password-reset` and `/phone-number/reset-password` with an SMS service) and a fresh sign-in with the new password is served (control); a reset that does not complete ends nothing; better-auth is handed the flag with no configuration; `false` is refused at construction and on a patch (standing config kept); `true`/absent accepted.
- `plugin-auth/src/reset-request-mail-after-response.test.ts` (new): a send that never settles still lets `POST /request-password-reset` answer, with the body an address with no account gets; the mail is still sent, after the response (control); a failed send is logged at error and the answer is unchanged; the server-side reset call still awaits its send; `runAfterResponse` failure handling.
- `qa/dogfood/test/password-reset-ends-sessions.dogfood.test.ts` (new): on the booted showcase, through the HTTP doors — the earlier session is served before the reset, refused (401) on the session door and a data read after it, and a fresh sign-in is served on both.
- Updated, because the public door's reset mail now lands after the response: `auth-email-locale.test.ts`, `identity-mail-sibling.test.ts`, `admin-import-users-invite-delivery-failure.test.ts` ⑥, and `identity-mail-read-gate.dogfood.test.ts` (waits for the new identity row instead of reading the newest one at once).

## Acceptance notes

- The phone OTP reset is pinned too (`password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts`, `plugins.phoneNumber` with an SMS service): the session signed in before a reset completed with the texted code answers 401 afterwards, and a fresh sign-in is served.
- A session a reset ends is deleted, not stamped: the reset paths are in neither the interactive-revoke ledger nor the erasure paths (`session-tombstone.ts`), so no `revoked_at` / `revoke_reason` trail is written and no `logout` audit row either (`logoutEventFor` records a `/sign-out` alone). The account's API keys are untouched. Parity with the forced reset's trail and key revocation is left to the maintainer.
- The after-response send lives as long as the process: a host that freezes its process right after the response would lose it. The platform's own Node server does not.
- `upgrade-harness/populate-fixture.ts` (the 18.0 fixture generator, never collected by vitest) requests a reset and does not read the mail row, so it is unchanged.
